value.rationale: A full, natural family of arbitrarily abrupt two-periodic mesh changes stays stable at order four in contrast with standard broad ratio restrictions; the exact Schur inequalities explain a non-obvious stability mechanism and the order-five counterexample sharply bounds the phenomenon. This is a motivated structural zero-stability boundary rather than a parameter-table recomputation.
